read.thesis: PPG grew organic sales 4% on 2% price and 2% volume, with Industrial volumes up 5% on share gains, but Performance Coatings margin fell 300bp and FY adjusted EPS guidance of $7.70–$8.10 was merely reaffirmed.

triggers.label: Cost inflation covered 90% in Q2
triggers.quote: In the second quarter we covered about 90% of the cost of goods sold inflation and expect to cover 100% by the fourth quarter

triggers.label: Packaging volumes up over 20% two-year
triggers.quote: sales volumes were up over 20% on a two-year stacked basis, due to share gains

triggers.label: Performance Coatings margin down 300bp
triggers.quote: segment EBITDA margin declined 300 basis points, driven by lower automotive refinish coatings sales volumes

triggers.label: Operating working capital up to 18.2% of sales
triggers.quote: As a percent of quarter sales, annualized 18.2 %

guidance.quote: We are reaffirming our full-year earnings per share guidance range of $7.70 to $8.10.
The company expects third quarter organic sales growth in the range of a low single-digit to a mid-single-digit percentage

guidance.value: flat to decline of 100 basis points
guidance.quote: company adjusted EBITDA margin in the range of flat to a decline of 100 basis points year over year

red_flags.label: Performance Coatings margin down 300bp on refinish
red_flags.quote: Organic sales in automotive refinish coatings decreased by a double-digit percentage as sales volumes were lower
